text:
Both give the correct values: January high 156.25, low 153.80; February high 163.90, low 161.80; March high 168.20, low 166.80.

Assistant A adds a preamble sentence, so the output isn't a pure CSV string, and it has no header, so the columns are unlabeled. It also doesn't say which value is the highest and which the lowest, though the order is implied.

Assistant B returns a clean CSV with a header (Month,High,Low) and consistent date-formatted months. This better meets "Return the results as a CSV string." The header makes the columns clear. Its only drawback is that the month format is YYYY-MM instead of the month name, which is fine.

B is better.

[[B]]
